# Certification reminder (copy/paste)

Subject: Action needed: certify your requested SciENcv document(s)

Hi [PI Name],

Your SciENcv drafts for this submission are ready. Please certify [your NIH Biosketch / your Current and Pending (Other) Support form / both forms] by [date].

[For an application: our records show your qualifying Research Security Training was completed on **[date]**, within the 12 months before submission. Please contact us before certifying if that date is incorrect.]

[If replacing an older PDF: please re-certify in SciENcv and provide a fresh download so we can replace the existing attachment and re-run submission validations. See the [September 2026 certificate alert]({{ site.baseurl }}{% link troubleshooting/september-2026-certificates.md %}).]

Sign in to your own SciENcv account and complete these steps for each requested document. Keep your password and verification codes private.

1. Open the document.
2. Select **Download PDF**.
3. Read the certification statement and select **Certify** to download the PDF.
4. Send us the certified PDF or let us know that it is ready for us to download.

Thanks!  
[Admin Name]
